headline: Southwest Airlines Shares Rise on Third-Quarter Earnings Beat
summary: Southwest Airlines shares rose after the airline reported third-quarter earnings that surpassed analyst estimates.
why: Southwest Airlines is one of the largest domestic air carriers in the United States. Its quarterly performance offers insight into consumer travel demand and jet fuel costs.

impacts.name: Southwest Airlines Co.
impacts.why: Shares climbed after third-quarter financial results came in above market expectations.

why_moved: Southwest Airlines reported third-quarter earnings that beat consensus estimates, lifting investor sentiment and pushing the stock higher.
